name: grid-tac-toe
description: Racing-themed tic-tac-toe for phones: single player vs the computer.

scripts.ios: cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.android: cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.android:bundle: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.assets: node scripts/render-web-icons.cjs && node scripts/render-assets.cjs && capacitor-assets generate --iconBackgroundColor '#0e0e14' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#0e0e14' --splashBackgroundColor '#0e0e14' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#0e0e14' --ios --android
